_comment: Datapoints that show how a host was weakened or hardened against its stock image.
Run together with osquery's own packs/windows-hardening.conf (UAC, DEP/ASLR/SEHOP, SecureBoot,
SRP/AppLocker, Sysmon, ...), which ships with osquery; this file only adds what that pack lacks:
remote access and network settings, shares, local admins, persistence, and the Linux side.
Stable columns only (no timestamps, pids, uptimes). Never a secret: Winlogon DefaultPassword is
reported as present, SSH keys by hash. ASA diffs (work/asa) find what this misses; add from there.

os.query: SELECT name, version, major, minor, patch, build, platform, arch FROM os_version;

packages_deb.query: SELECT name, version, arch FROM deb_packages ORDER BY name;

packages_rpm.query: SELECT name, version, release, arch FROM rpm_packages ORDER BY name;

systemd_units.query: SELECT id, unit_file_state, fragment_path FROM systemd_units WHERE unit_file_state != '' ORDER BY id;

kernel_modules.query: SELECT name FROM kernel_modules ORDER BY name;

suid_sgid.query: SELECT path, username, groupname, permissions FROM suid_bin ORDER BY path;

file_capabilities.query: SELECT x.path, x.value FROM file f JOIN extended_attributes x ON x.path = f.path WHERE (f.path LIKE '/usr/bin/%' OR f.path LIKE '/usr/sbin/%' OR f.path LIKE '/usr/libexec/%%' OR f.path LIKE '/usr/lib/%/%') AND f.type = 'regular' AND x.key = 'security.capability' ORDER BY x.path;

sysctl_net.query: SELECT DISTINCT name, current_value FROM system_controls WHERE name LIKE 'net.ipv4.conf.all.%' OR name LIKE 'net.ipv4.conf.default.%' OR name LIKE 'net.ipv6.conf.all.%' OR name LIKE 'net.ipv6.conf.default.%' OR name IN ('net.ipv4.ip_forward','net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies','net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts','kernel.kptr_restrict','kernel.dmesg_restrict','kernel.yama.ptrace_scope','kernel.unprivileged_bpf_disabled','kernel.randomize_va_space','kernel.sysrq','fs.protected_symlinks','fs.protected_hardlinks','fs.suid_dumpable') ORDER BY name;

sshd_config.query: SELECT label, value FROM augeas WHERE path = '/etc/ssh/sshd_config' AND label IN ('PermitRootLogin','PasswordAuthentication','PubkeyAuthentication','PermitEmptyPasswords','X11Forwarding','AllowTcpForwarding','GatewayPorts','ListenAddress','Port','UsePAM','KbdInteractiveAuthentication') ORDER BY label;

selinux.query: SELECT scope, key, value FROM selinux_settings WHERE scope IN ('', 'booleans') ORDER BY scope, key;

apparmor.query: SELECT name, mode FROM apparmor_profiles ORDER BY name;

users_linux.query: SELECT username, uid, gid, shell, directory FROM users ORDER BY uid;

privileged_groups.query: SELECT g.groupname, u.username FROM user_groups ug JOIN users u USING (uid) JOIN groups g USING (gid) WHERE g.groupname IN ('sudo','wheel','admin','adm','docker','lxd','libvirt','disk','shadow') ORDER BY g.groupname, u.username;

sudoers.query: SELECT source, header, rule_details FROM sudoers ORDER BY source, header;

authorized_keys.query: SELECT u.username, ak.algorithm, hex(sha256(ak.key)) AS key_sha256 FROM users u JOIN authorized_keys ak USING (uid) ORDER BY u.username;

crontab.query: SELECT path, minute, hour, day_of_month, month, day_of_week, command FROM crontab ORDER BY path, command;

services_windows.query: SELECT name, start_type, service_type, path, user_account FROM services ORDER BY name;

registry_datapoints.query: SELECT path, CASE WHEN name = 'DefaultPassword' THEN '<present>' ELSE data END AS data FROM registry WHERE path IN ('HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\LmCompatibilityLevel','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RunAsPPL','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\RestrictAnonymous','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\NoLMHash','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\DisableRestrictedAdmin','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest\UseLogonCredential','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\FilterAdministratorToken','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient\EnableMulticast','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters\RequireSecuritySignature','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters\EnableSecuritySignature','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters\SMB1','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanWorkstation\Parameters\RequireSecuritySignature','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters\LDAPServerIntegrity','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NTDS\Parameters\LdapEnforceChannelBinding','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WSMAN\Service\auth_basic','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WSMAN\Service\allow_unencrypted','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Service\AllowBasic','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WinRM\Service\AllowUnencryptedTraffic','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\fDenyTSConnections','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp\UserAuthentication','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp\SecurityLayer','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\AutoAdminLogon','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\DefaultUserName','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\DefaultPassword','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\DisableAntiSpyware','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\DomainProfile\EnableFirewall','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\StandardProfile\EnableFirewall','HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SharedAccess\Parameters\FirewallPolicy\PublicProfile\EnableFirewall') ORDER BY path;

defender_exclusions.query: SELECT key, name FROM registry WHERE key LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Exclusions\%' ORDER BY key, name;

netbios_over_tcpip.query: SELECT data FROM registry WHERE key LIKE 'HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\NetBT\Parameters\Interfaces\%' AND name = 'NetbiosOptions' GROUP BY data ORDER BY data;

shares.query: SELECT name, path, type FROM shared_resources ORDER BY name;

local_admins.query: SELECT g.groupname, u.username FROM user_groups ug JOIN users u USING (uid) JOIN groups g USING (gid) WHERE g.groupname IN ('Administrators','Remote Desktop Users','Remote Management Users','Backup Operators','Server Operators') ORDER BY g.groupname, u.username;

users_windows.query: SELECT username, type, shell FROM users WHERE type = 'local' ORDER BY username;

scheduled_tasks.query: SELECT path, action, enabled, hidden FROM scheduled_tasks ORDER BY path;

wmi_persistence.query: SELECT 'filter' AS kind, name, query AS detail FROM wmi_event_filters UNION ALL SELECT 'cli', name, command_line_template FROM wmi_cli_event_consumers UNION ALL SELECT 'script', name, scripting_engine FROM wmi_script_event_consumers ORDER BY kind, name;

drivers.query: SELECT service, image, signed, provider FROM drivers WHERE service != '' GROUP BY service ORDER BY service;

certificates_machine.query: SELECT store, sha1, common_name FROM certificates WHERE store_location = 'LocalMachine' ORDER BY store, sha1;

firewall_rules.query: SELECT * FROM windows_firewall_rules ORDER BY name;
firewall_rules._comment: osquery reads rules via INetFwPolicy2; firru's loot-host.ps1 firewall.json (ActiveStore, GPO merged) stays the reference until a GPO host shows whether this matches it.

optional_features.query: SELECT name, state FROM windows_optional_features WHERE state = 1 ORDER BY name;

programs.query: SELECT name, version, publisher FROM programs ORDER BY name;

security_products.query: SELECT type, name, state, signatures_up_to_date FROM windows_security_products ORDER BY type, name;

patches.query: SELECT hotfix_id FROM patches ORDER BY hotfix_id;
